## Findings
- claim-1: RWY Theorem 4.8 works integrally in \(H^\star(G/P_J,\mathbb Z)\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) and gives the two Schur generating families for \(J_v\), with \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\) and \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-892]
- claim-2: RWY’s proof uses vertical-strip Pieri identities and degree inductions; the supplied passage gives no Smith-form, determinantal-divisor, or unimodular-minor statement. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1005-1041]
- claim-3: St. Dizier–Yong prove lower-adjoined-family minimality for \(J_v\subseteq\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), under \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), and \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- claim-4: Their proof reduces Littlewood–Richardson syzygies to tall/wide linear equations and a coproduct-tensor algorithm, rather than stating a degreewise Pieri-matrix Smith-form or unimodular-complement theorem. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 254-261]
